      "source": [
        "# Codomax AI & ML Internship\n",
        "\n",
        "## Module 6 – Final AI & ML Project\n",
        "\n",
        "### Student Performance Prediction using Machine Learning\n",
        "\n",
        "This project uses student performance data to train a Machine Learning model that predicts a student's final performance based on selected academic factors.\n",
        "\n",
        "### Technologies Used\n",
        "\n",
        "- Python\n",
        "- Pandas\n",
        "- NumPy\n",
        "- Matplotlib\n",
        "- Scikit-learn\n",
        "- Google Colab\n",
        "\n",
        "### Machine Learning Workflow\n",
        "\n",
        "1. Load the dataset\n",
        "2. Explore the dataset\n",
        "3. Clean the data\n",
        "4. Select features\n",
        "5. Split the data\n",
        "6. Train the Machine Learning model\n",
        "7. Make predictions\n",
        "8. Evaluate the model\n",
        "9. Test predictions with new data"
      ]
    },

      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import zipfile\n",
        "import requests\n",
        "from io import BytesIO\n",
        "\n",
        "url = \"https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/machine-learning-databases/00320/student.zip\"\n",
        "\n",
        "response = requests.get(url)\n",
        "\n",
        "with zipfile.ZipFile(BytesIO(response.content)) as z:\n",
        "    with z.open(\"student-mat.csv\") as file:\n",
        "        df = pd.read_csv(file, sep=\";\")\n",
        "\n",
        "df.head()"
      ]
    },

      "source": [
        "## Conclusion\n",
        "\n",
        "This project demonstrates a complete Machine Learning workflow for predicting student final performance.\n",
        "\n",
        "The student performance dataset was accessed directly from an online ZIP dataset using Python and Pandas. The data was explored, checked for missing values and duplicates, and prepared for Machine Learning.\n",
        "\n",
        "The selected features were study time, previous failures, absences, G1, and G2. A Linear Regression model was trained using an 80/20 train-test split.\n",
        "\n",
        "The model was evaluated using MAE, MSE, RMSE, and R² score. Actual and predicted values were also compared using a visualization.\n",
        "\n",
        "Finally, the trained model was used to predict the final grade of a new student based on their academic information.\n",
        "\n",
        "Through this project, I gained practical experience in data preprocessing, data visualization, feature selection, model training, prediction, model evaluation, and building an interactive Machine Learning application."
      ],
